title: AI Chatbot Recommendations Redirect Users to Cryptojacking Malware Sites
summary: Microsoft has warned of an active cryptojacking campaign that makes use of artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot interactions as a mechanism for surfacing malicious download sites.
